pages.name: national_statistical_system
pages.title: Part 2 - National statistical system
pages.description: Please answer the following questions about the national statistical system. Concise but informative responses are sufficient. If an issue is not applicable, please briefly explain why.

elements.name: members_q1
elements.title: Which State agencies, apart from the National Statistical Office, are in practice considered producing official statistics in accordance with articles 2 and 17 of the Statistical Services Act 1980 and therewith practically members of the national statistical system?

elements.name: coordination_q1
elements.title: How does the National Statistical Office in practice exert its power to coordinate the national statistical system in accordance with article 4 of the Statistical Services Act 1980?

elements.name: coordination_q2
elements.title: What mechanism(s) is/are in place to ensure the coordination of the production and dissemination of official statistics across the national statistical system, including with respect to multi-year and/or annual programming, the use of common standards and practices, and the sharing of resources and expertise?

elements.name: data_sources_q1
elements.title: Please list the censuses and sample surveys the national statistical system is currently conducting and planning to conduct over the next five years. Please also list the registers, other administrative data sources, any non-traditional data sources (such as global positioning data, earth observation data, transaction data, mobile phone data, etc.), and data integration techniques used in statistical production processes.

elements.name: access_q1
elements.title: How does the National Statistical Office in practice ensure access to administrative data in accordance with article 5 of the Statistical Services Act 1980?

elements.name: quality_assurance_q1
elements.title: Please describe the quality assurance policy and instruments the national statistical system is using. This may include a quality assurance framework; using GSBPM (Generic Statistical Business Process Model) checklists and quality indicators for the design of statistical business processes; validation procedures at data capture; editing and imputation procedures at data processing; and producing, and possibly publishing, producer-oriented and user-oriented quality reports.

elements.name: consultation_q1
elements.title: What mechanism(s) is/are in place to ensure that the official statistics produced throughout the national statistical system continuously meet the evolving needs of all possible users, including State agencies, the public, businesses, researchers and the media?
